=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/annotation_link.py ===
"""Conservative annotation spelling fallback: a type variable is not java.lang."""
import re
from parsers import annotations,split_top,typ
def formal_names(raw):
 clean=annotations(raw)[0];starts=[]
 type_match=re.search(r'\b(?:class|interface|enum)\s+[\w.$]+\s*(<)',clean)
 if type_match:starts.append(type_match.start(1))
 prefix=clean.split('(',1)[0]
 for match in re.finditer(r'(?<![\w.$])<',prefix):starts.append(match.start())
 names=set()
 for start in starts:
  depth=0;end=None
  for i,c in enumerate(clean[start:],start):
   if c=='<':depth+=1
   elif c=='>':
    depth-=1
    if depth==0:end=i;break
  if end is None:continue
  for part in split_top(clean[start+1:end]):
   m=re.match(r'\s*([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)',part)
   if m:names.add(m.group(1))
 return names
def same_snapshot_source_ids(db,bid,annotation_source,source_by_id):
 # An explicit platform version plus the same repository commit proves the
 # legacy signature and annotation archives belong to one source snapshot.
 if not all(annotation_source.get(k) for k in ('repository','revision','platform_api_version')):return set()
 return {source_id for source_id, in db.execute('SELECT source_id FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=?',(bid,)) if source_by_id[source_id]['kind']=='sdk-signature' and all(source_by_id[source_id].get(k)==annotation_source[k] for k in ('repository','revision','platform_api_version'))}
def snapshot_declared_type_matches(db,bid,item_name,eligible_source_ids,sha):
 import json
 target=re.sub(r'\s+\d+$','',item_name);owner,sep,tail=target.partition(' ')
 if not sep:return True # type/package target; it declares no return/field type
 if '(' in tail:
  head=tail.split('(',1)[0];name=re.search(r'[\w$]+$',head)
  if not name:return False
  expected=typ(head[:name.start()]) or None
 else:
  head=tail.rsplit(' ',1)
  if len(head)!=2:return False
  expected=typ(head[0])
 checked=[]
 for source_id,raw in db.execute('SELECT source_id,document_json FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=?',(bid,)):
  if source_id not in eligible_source_ids:continue
  doc=json.loads(raw);actual=doc.get('return_type',{}).get('text')
  if expected is None:checked.append(doc['kind']=='constructor' and actual is None);continue
  if actual==expected:checked.append(True);continue
  shortened=re.sub(r'(?<![\w.$])java\.lang\.','',expected)
  if actual!=shortened:checked.append(False);continue
  header=db.execute('SELECT document_json FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=? AND source_id=?',(sha('java:'+doc.get('owner','')),source_id)).fetchone()
  if not header:checked.append(False);continue
  roots=set(re.findall(r'(?<![\w.$])java\.lang\.([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)',expected));formals=formal_names(doc['provenance'][0]['raw_signature'])|formal_names(json.loads(header[0])['provenance'][0]['raw_signature']);checked.append(not bool(roots&formals))
 return bool(checked) and all(checked)
def fallback_supported(db,bid,xml_canonical,source_by_id,sha,eligible_source_ids=None):
 # The SDK's signature format supplies the abbreviation evidence. Do not
 # infer a java.lang class from an identically spelled formal type variable.
 roots=set(re.findall(r'(?<![\w.$])java\.lang\.([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)',xml_canonical.split('(',1)[-1]));evidence=[]
 for source_id,document in db.execute('SELECT source_id,document_json FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=?',(bid,)):
  if eligible_source_ids is not None and source_id not in eligible_source_ids:continue
  if source_by_id[source_id]['kind']!='sdk-signature':continue
  import json
  doc=json.loads(document);owner=doc.get('owner');header=db.execute('SELECT document_json FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=? AND source_id=?',(sha('java:'+owner),source_id)).fetchone() if owner else None
  if not header:return False
  method_raw=doc['provenance'][0]['raw_signature'];owner_raw=json.loads(header[0])['provenance'][0]['raw_signature']
  evidence.append(not (roots & (formal_names(method_raw)|formal_names(owner_raw))))
 return bool(evidence) and all(evidence)

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/build_catalog.py ===
"""Offline reproducible catalog import. No network, devices, or bridge application.
Usage: python build_catalog.py INVENTORY OUTPUT
Sources' local_path is relative to inventory.parent. Refuses populated output.
"""
import pathlib,json,sqlite3,hashlib,datetime,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,zipfile,collections,os,re,gzip
from parsers import signature,aidl,aidl_all,permission,unknown,sha,split_top,typ
from aidl_members import enrich as enrich_aidl
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def js(x):return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)
def hb(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def processing_fingerprint():
 return sha(js({name:hb((P/name).read_bytes()) for name in ('tooling/build_catalog.py','tooling/cache_fingerprint.py','tooling/parsers.py','tooling/aidl_members.py','tooling/aidl_lex.py','tooling/foundation_extract.py','tooling/java_source.py','tooling/sdk_api_index.py','tooling/jvm_source_link.py','tooling/java_context.py','tooling/annotation_link.py','contracts/Entry.schema.json','contracts/PermissionExpression.schema.json')}))
def ref(text):return dict(text=text,status='unknown',codec_status='unknown',reason='Source type retained; runtime resolver/codec not verified')
def cached_records(s,root):
 cache=s.get('metadata_cache')
 if not cache:raise ValueError('Missing declaration cache '+s['path'])
 path=root/cache['path']
 if hb(path.read_bytes())!=cache['sha256']:raise ValueError('Metadata cache SHA256 mismatch '+s['path'])
 from cache_fingerprint import current
 if cache.get('parser_sha256')!=current(s['kind']):raise ValueError('Stale parser cache: regenerate with current producer '+s['path'])
 count=0
 with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
  for line in f:count+=1;yield json.loads(line)
 if count!=cache['records']:raise ValueError('Metadata cache count mismatch '+s['path'])
def _build(inventory,output,connections):
 invpath=pathlib.Path(inventory).resolve();root=invpath.parent;spec=json.loads(invpath.read_text());out=pathlib.Path(output).resolve()
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 if list(out.iterdir()):raise ValueError('Output must be empty; preserve immutable earlier publication')
 meta=spec.get('catalog')
 if not isinstance(meta,dict) or any(k not in meta for k in ('registry_version','android_version','api_level','coverage')):raise ValueError('Required catalog metadata is absent')
 if not isinstance(meta['registry_version'],int) or isinstance(meta['registry_version'],bool) or meta['registry_version']<1:raise ValueError('registry_version must be a positive integer')
 if not isinstance(meta['api_level'],int) or isinstance(meta['api_level'],bool) or meta['api_level']<1:raise ValueError('Target catalog api_level must be a positive integer')
 if not all(isinstance(meta[k],str) and meta[k] for k in ('android_version','coverage')):raise ValueError('Catalog version/coverage must be nonempty strings')
 sources=[s for s in spec['sources'] if s['status']=='downloaded'];processor_hash=processing_fingerprint()
 sources.sort(key=lambda s:0 if s['kind']=='sdk-api-index' else 1)
 for source in sources:
  if 'api_level' not in source or not isinstance(source.get('channel'),str) or not source['channel']:raise ValueError('Explicit source api_level/channel metadata required')
  level=source['api_level']
  if level is not None and (not isinstance(level,int) or isinstance(level,bool) or level<1):raise ValueError('Source api_level must be positive or null (unknown)')

 db=sqlite3.connect(out/'catalog.staging.sqlite');db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON');db.execute('PRAGMA cache_size=-524288');db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')
 connections.append(db)
 db.executescript((P/'migrations/001-initial.sql').read_text());db.executescript((P/'migrations/002-evidence-and-publication.sql').read_text())
 db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
 for s in sources:
  b=(root/s['local_path']).read_bytes()
  if hb(b)!=s['sha256']:raise ValueError('SHA256 mismatch '+s['path'])
  if hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()!=s['git_blob']:raise ValueError('Git blob mismatch '+s['path'])
  acquisition={k:s.get(k) for k in ('url','revision','sha256','retrieved_at','path','api_level','channel','kind','license','scope')}
  source_processor=processor_hash
  if s.get('metadata_cache'):
   source_processor=sha(js(dict(processor=processor_hash,cache_sha256=s['metadata_cache']['sha256'],cache_parser_sha256=s['metadata_cache'].get('parser_sha256'),java_file_context=s.get('java_file_context'))))
  s['source_id']=sha(js(dict(acquisition=acquisition,processing_sha256=source_processor)));s['x-source-identity-version']=3;s['x-processing-sha256']=source_processor
  db.execute('INSERT INTO sources VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(s['source_id'],s['path'],s['url'],s['revision'],s['retrieved_at'],s['sha256'],s['api_level'],s['channel'],s['kind'],s['license']))
  db.execute('INSERT INTO source_details VALUES (?,?)',(s['source_id'],js(s)))
 set_hash=sha(js(sorted(s['source_id'] for s in sources)));registry_id=sha(js(dict(source_set_hash=set_hash,metadata=meta)))
 # This private staging database is not published until every validation/export gate passes.
 db.execute('INSERT INTO registries VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(registry_id,meta['registry_version'],'1.2.0',meta['android_version'],meta['api_level'],set_hash,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'staged','{}'))
 db.execute('UPDATE catalog_view SET registry_generation=? WHERE singleton=1',(meta['registry_version'],))
 source_by_id={s['source_id']:s for s in sources};symbols_by_value=collections.defaultdict(set);symbol_rows=[]
 # Separate constant pass avoids source order changing symbolic permission resolution.
 for s in sources:
  if s['kind'] not in ('sdk-signature','source-signature','java-source'):continue
  records=cached_records(s,root) if s['kind']=='java-source' else signature((root/s['local_path']).read_text())
  for r in records:
   if r['kind']=='field' and r['extras'].get('constant_raw'):
    value=r['extras']['constant_raw']
    try:value=json.loads(value)
    except ValueError:continue
    if isinstance(value,str) and ('.permission.' in value or (r['owner'] or '').endswith('.permission')):
     symbol=r['owner']+'.'+r['name'];symbols_by_value[symbol].add(value);symbol_rows.append((symbol,value,s['source_id'],r['line']))
 symbols={k:next(iter(v)) for k,v in symbols_by_value.items() if len(v)==1}
 db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO permission_symbols VALUES (?,?,?,?)',symbol_rows)
 exact_index_targets={};index_versions={};jvm_owners={};jvm_keys={};linked_permissions=0
 for s in sources:
  if s['kind']=='sdk-api-index':
   detected=set()
   for r in cached_records(s,root):
    platform=str(r['extras'].get('target_platform_api',''))
    if not platform:raise ValueError('API index cache lacks target platform version')
    if s.get('platform_api_version') is not None and str(s['platform_api_version'])!=platform:raise ValueError('API index target platform mismatch')
    detected.add(platform)
    if '#' not in r['canonical']:jvm_owners.setdefault(platform,{})[r['owner']]=r['extras']['jvm_owner']
    jvm_keys.setdefault(platform,{})[r['canonical']]=sha('jvm:'+r['canonical'])
   if len(detected)>1:raise ValueError('API index cache mixes target platform versions')
   index_versions[s['source_id']]=str(s.get('platform_api_version') or next(iter(detected),''))
   exact_index_targets.setdefault(index_versions[s['source_id']],{})
 def issue(s,line,reason,raw,category='unsupported'):
  db.execute('INSERT INTO issues(source_id,line,category,reason,raw) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(s['source_id'],line,category,reason,raw))
 def add(r,s,lang='java'):
  nonlocal linked_permissions
  canonical=lang+':'+('package:' if r['kind']=='package' else '')+r['canonical'];bid=sha(canonical);line=r['line'];ast=permission(r['annotations'],symbols,lang=='aidl')
  extensions=dict(language=lang,source_kind=s['kind'],source_path=s['path'],source_scope=s['scope'],annotations=r['all_annotations'],parameters=r['parameters']);extensions.update(r['extras']);target_jvm=None
  if lang=='java-source':
   from jvm_source_link import key as source_jvm_key
   platform=str(s.get('platform_api_version',''));candidate=source_jvm_key(r,jvm_owners.get(platform,{}))
   if candidate in jvm_keys.get(platform,{}):extensions['proven_current_sdk_jvm_identity']=candidate;target_jvm=jvm_keys[platform][candidate]
   extensions['identity_scope']='Source-spelled type identity; wildcard/type-variable resolution unknown; no JVM equivalence inferred without proof'
  elif lang=='jvm':extensions['identity_scope']='Published JVM owner/member key; methods include descriptors; field descriptor/type and Java type kind may be unknown'
  doc=dict(schema_version='1.0.0',entry_id=bid,canonical_signature=canonical,kind=r['kind'],name=r['name'],package=r['package'],permission=ast,provenance=[dict(source_id=s['source_id'],line=line,raw_signature=r['raw'],source_revision=s['revision'])],origin='imported',state='active',registry_version=meta['registry_version'],overlay_revision=0,codec_status='unknown',unresolved=['OS authority, MCP client grants and wire codecs are not established by catalog metadata'],required_semantics=[],extensions=extensions)
  if r['kind'] in ('aidl-parcelable','aidl-union','aidl-enum','type'):doc['schema_version']='1.1.0'
  if r['owner'] is not None:doc['owner']=r['owner']
  for parameter in doc['extensions']['parameters']:parameter['permission']=permission(parameter['annotations'],symbols,lang=='aidl')
  doc['arguments']=[ref(x['type']) for x in r['parameters']]
  if r['return_type'] is not None:doc['return_type']=ref(r['return_type'])
  if r['kind']=='unsupported':doc['unresolved'].append(r['extras'].get('parse_error','Structured AIDL members unresolved'))
  db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO bindings(binding_id,signature,package,owner,kind,name,return_type,arguments_json,raw_signature) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(bid,canonical,r['package'],r['owner'],r['kind'],r['name'],r['return_type'],js([x['type'] for x in r['parameters']]),r['raw']))
  # Duplicate declaration at the exact same locator is a defect, never silently ignored.
  db.execute('INSERT INTO occurrences VALUES (?,?,?)',(bid,s['source_id'],line))
  db.execute('INSERT INTO binding_declarations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(bid,s['source_id'],line,js(doc),sha(js(doc))))
  db.execute('INSERT INTO permission_relations(binding_id,source_id,line,annotation,logic,expression_json,raw_annotation) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(bid,s['source_id'],line,','.join(a['name'] for a in r['annotations']) or None,ast['op'],js(ast),js(r['annotations'])))
  if target_jvm and ast['op']!='unknown':
   db.execute('INSERT INTO permission_relations(binding_id,source_id,line,annotation,logic,expression_json,raw_annotation) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(target_jvm,s['source_id'],line,'source declaration; exact JVM descriptor link',ast['op'],js(ast),js(r['annotations'])));linked_permissions+=1
  if lang=='jvm':
   target=r['owner'] if '#' not in r['canonical'] else r['owner']+'#'+r['name']+('('+','.join(p['type'] for p in r['parameters'])+')' if r['kind'] in ('method','constructor') else '')
   targets=exact_index_targets[index_versions[s['source_id']]]
   if target in targets and targets[target]!=bid:targets[target]=None
   else:targets[target]=bid
  if r['kind']=='unsupported':issue(s,line,r['extras'].get('parse_error','Structured AIDL body retained without semantic parse'),r['raw'])
  return bid
 totals=collections.Counter();per_source=[]
 for i,s in enumerate(sources):
  kind=s['kind'];sid=s['source_id'];path=root/s['local_path'];report=dict(source_id=sid,kind=kind,input_bytes=s['size_bytes'],declarations=0,unsupported=0,status='retained')
  if kind in ('sdk-signature','source-signature'):
   text=path.read_text();expected=sum(bool(l.strip()) and not l.strip().startswith('//') and l.strip()!='}' for l in text.splitlines())
   for r in signature(text):add(r,s);report['declarations']+=1;report['unsupported']+=r['kind']=='unsupported'
   if expected!=report['declarations']:raise ValueError('Signature reconciliation failed '+s['path'])
   report.update(expected_declarations=expected,status='partial' if report['unsupported'] else 'parsed')
  elif kind in ('java-source','sdk-api-index'):
   for r in cached_records(s,root):
    add(r,s,'jvm' if kind=='sdk-api-index' else 'java-source');report['declarations']+=1;report['unsupported']+=r['kind']=='unsupported'
   report.update(expected_declarations=s['metadata_cache']['records'],status='partial' if report['unsupported'] else 'parsed',semantic_scope='Source declarations; public membership not inferred from visibility' if kind=='java-source' else 'Current platform lifecycle index; field types and type kinds may be unknown')
  elif kind=='manifest':
   try:
    xml=ET.fromstring(path.read_bytes());ns='{http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android}'
    defs=list(xml.iter('permission'));report['permission_elements']=len(defs)
    for node in defs:
     name=node.attrib.get(ns+'name')
     if name is None:issue(s,None,'Permission element lacks name',ET.tostring(node,encoding='unicode'));continue
     try:db.execute('INSERT INTO permission_definitions VALUES (?,?,?,?)',(name,sid,node.attrib.get(ns+'protectionLevel'),js(dict(attributes=node.attrib,children=[ET.tostring(c,encoding='unicode') for c in node]))))
     except sqlite3.IntegrityError:issue(s,None,'Duplicate permission name in one manifest; raw element retained',ET.tostring(node,encoding='unicode'),'duplicate')
    report['status']='parsed'
   except ET.ParseError as e:issue(s,None,'Manifest XML unresolved: '+str(e),path.read_text(errors='replace'));report['status']='unsupported'
  elif kind=='aidl':
   text=path.read_text()
   try:
    parsed=aidl_all(text);declarations=[]
    for item in parsed:
     # Mask all other declarations while keeping full physical line numbering.
     span=item.get('declaration_span');fragment=text
     if span:
      fragment=''.join('\n' if c=='\n' else ' ' for c in text[:span[0]])+text[span[0]:span[1]]
     declarations.append(enrich_aidl(fragment,item))
   except ValueError as error:
    declarations=[dict(package='',descriptor=None,declaration_kind=None,imports=[],annotations=[],members=[],parse_status='unsupported',reason='AIDL annotation/syntax unresolved: '+str(error))]
   states=[d['parse_status'] for d in declarations]
   roots=[d for d in declarations if d.get('declaration_depth',0)==0]
   status='partial' if len(declarations)>1 and any(v in ('unsupported','partial','field-metadata-partial') for v in states) else roots[0]['parse_status'] if len(roots)==1 else 'declarations-inventoried'
   first=roots[0] if roots else declarations[0]
   metadata=dict(imports=first['imports'],wire_status='unknown',declarations=[{k:d.get(k) for k in ('descriptor','declaration_kind','parse_status','reason','declaration_line','declaration_ordinal','declaration_span','parent_descriptor','declaration_depth')} for d in declarations])
   db.execute('INSERT INTO aidl_schemas VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(sid,first['package'],first['descriptor'] if len(roots)==1 and first['declaration_kind']=='interface' else None,first['declaration_kind'] if len(roots)==1 else 'multiple',text,status,js(metadata),'unknown'))
   member_count=0
   for d in declarations:
    if d['descriptor']:
     root_kind='unsupported' if d['parse_status']=='unsupported' else 'aidl-'+d['declaration_kind']
     r=dict(kind=root_kind,canonical=d['descriptor'],package=d['package'],owner=d['descriptor'],name=d['descriptor'].split('.')[-1],return_type=None,parameters=[],annotations=d['annotations'],all_annotations=d['annotations'],raw=d.get('declaration_header',d.get('declaration_raw',text)),line=d.get('declaration_line',1),extras=dict(aidl_kind=d['declaration_kind'],imports=d['imports'],parse_status=d['parse_status'],oneway=d.get('oneway'),schema_resolution_reason=d['reason'],declaration_ordinal=d.get('declaration_ordinal',0)))
     r['extras']['parent_descriptor']=d.get('parent_descriptor');r['extras']['declaration_depth']=d.get('declaration_depth',0)
     if root_kind=='unsupported':r['extras']['parse_error']=d['reason']
    else:r=dict(kind='unsupported',canonical='unparsed-source:'+s['repository']+':'+s['path']+':'+s['sha256'],owner=None,package=d['package'],name=s['path'].rsplit('/',1)[-1],return_type=None,parameters=[],annotations=[],all_annotations=[],raw=text,line=1,extras=dict(parse_error=d['reason'],source_bytes_retained=True))
    add(r,s,'aidl');report['declarations']+=1;report['unsupported']+=r['kind']=='unsupported'
    for r in d['members']:
     r['extras']['interface_annotations']=d['annotations'];r['extras']['interface_permission']=permission(d['annotations'],symbols,True)
     add(r,s,'aidl');report['declarations']+=1;report['unsupported']+=r['kind']=='unsupported';member_count+=1
    if d['parse_status'] not in ('methods-parsed','field-metadata-parsed'):issue(s,d.get('declaration_line'),d['reason'],d.get('declaration_raw',text),'aidl-semantic-gap')
   from aidl_lex import inventory_counts
   lexical=inventory_counts(text)
   whole_file_unknown=len(declarations)==1 and declarations[0]['descriptor'] is None
   reconciled=lexical['reconciled'] and not (whole_file_unknown and lexical['declarations'])
   if reconciled and (lexical['declarations'] and lexical['declarations']!=len(declarations) or lexical['expected_records']!=report['declarations']):raise ValueError('AIDL reconciliation failed '+s['path'])
   if not reconciled:issue(s,None,'AIDL lexical reconciliation unresolved; full source retained',text,'aidl-reconciliation')
   report.update(status=status,member_chunks=member_count,declaration_count=len(declarations),aidl_lexical_inventory=lexical,aidl_reconciliation='matched' if reconciled else 'unreconciled')
   if reconciled:report['expected_declarations']=lexical['expected_records']
  elif kind=='sdk-annotations':report['status']='deferred-external-annotation-pass'
  elif kind in ('evidence','sdk-history'):report['status']='retained-evidence-not-current-declarations'
  else:issue(s,None,'Unrecognized source kind',kind);report['status']='unsupported'
  per_source.append(report);totals[kind]+=1
  if i%200==0:print('parsed sources',i,'/',len(sources),flush=True)
 # External annotations are retained in full and mapped only when an exact source signature proves the target.
 for s in sources:
  if s['kind']!='sdk-annotations':continue
  report=next(x for x in per_source if x['source_id']==s['source_id']);report.update(xml_documents=0,items=0,annotations=0,mapped_annotations=0,status='parsed')
  with zipfile.ZipFile(root/s['local_path']) as archive:
   for filename in sorted(archive.namelist()):
    if not filename.endswith('.xml'):issue(s,None,'Unrecognized annotation archive member',filename);continue
    try:data=ET.fromstring(archive.read(filename))
    except ET.ParseError as error:
     issue(s,None,'Malformed external annotation XML '+filename+': '+str(error),archive.read(filename).decode(errors='replace'),'annotation-xml');report['status']='partial';continue
    report['xml_documents']+=1
    for ordinal,item in enumerate(data.findall('item')):
     report['items']+=1;name=item.attrib.get('name','');scope='declaration';target=name
     pidx=re.search(r'\s+(\d+)$',target)
     if pidx:scope='parameter:'+pidx.group(1);target=target[:pidx.start()]
     owner,sep,tail=target.partition(' ')
     canonical=None
     if not sep:canonical=owner
     elif '(' in tail:
      a=tail.find('(');b=tail.rfind(')');m=re.search(r'([\w$]+)$',tail[:a]);method=m.group(1) if m else None
      if method:canonical=owner+'#'+('<init>' if method==owner.split('.')[-1] else method)+'('+','.join(typ(x) for x in split_top(tail[a+1:b]) if x.strip())+')'
     else:canonical=owner+'#'+tail.split()[-1]
     target_match_kind='exact';matched_canonical=canonical
     candidates=[canonical] if canonical else []
     if sep and canonical and '(' in canonical:
      head,args=canonical.split('(',1)
      short=re.sub(r'(?<![\w.$])java\.lang\.', '',args)
      if short!=args:candidates.append(head+'('+short)
     elif not sep:candidates=[owner,'package:'+owner]
     if s.get('platform_api_version') is not None:
      platform=str(s['platform_api_version']);current=exact_index_targets.get(platform,{}).get(canonical)
      matches=[(canonical,current)] if current else []
      if not sep:
       package_candidate='java-source:package:'+owner;package_bid=sha(package_candidate)
       if any(item['kind']=='java-source' and str(item.get('platform_api_version',''))==platform for item in sources) and db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bindings WHERE binding_id=?',(package_bid,)).fetchone():matches.append((package_candidate,package_bid))
      target_match_kind='current-sdk-index-exact'
      if not matches and platform not in index_versions.values():
       from annotation_link import fallback_supported,same_snapshot_source_ids,snapshot_declared_type_matches
       for candidate in dict.fromkeys(candidates):
        candidate_bid=sha('java:'+candidate);eligible=same_snapshot_source_ids(db,candidate_bid,s,source_by_id)
        if eligible and snapshot_declared_type_matches(db,candidate_bid,name,eligible,sha) and (candidate==canonical or not sep or fallback_supported(db,candidate_bid,canonical,source_by_id,sha,eligible)):matches.append((candidate,candidate_bid))
       target_match_kind='same-snapshot-sdk-signature'
     else:
      from annotation_link import fallback_supported
      matches=[(candidate,sha('java:'+candidate)) for candidate in dict.fromkeys(candidates) if db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bindings WHERE binding_id=?',(sha('java:'+candidate),)).fetchone() and (candidate==canonical or not sep or fallback_supported(db,sha('java:'+candidate),canonical,source_by_id,sha))]
     bid=None
     if len(matches)==1:
      matched_canonical,bid=matches[0]
      if matched_canonical!=canonical:target_match_kind=('same-snapshot-sdk-signature-' if target_match_kind=='same-snapshot-sdk-signature' else '')+('java-lang-spelling-equivalence' if sep else 'package-namespace')
     else:target_match_kind='unresolved-or-ambiguous'
     anns=[]
     for ai,node in enumerate(item.findall('annotation')):
      a=dict(name=node.attrib.get('name',''),arguments=','.join(v.attrib.get('name','')+'='+v.attrib.get('val','') for v in node.findall('val')),raw=ET.tostring(node,encoding='unicode'),values=[dict(v.attrib) for v in node.findall('val')]);anns.append(a)
      a['permission']=permission([a],symbols)
      evidence=dict(item_name=name,archive_member=filename,item_ordinal=ordinal,annotation=a,target_resolution='exact' if bid else 'unknown',target_match_kind=target_match_kind,matched_canonical_signature=matched_canonical if bid else None,target_resolution_reason=None if bid else 'Target absent or ambiguous in the acquired declaration inventory')
      db.execute('INSERT INTO annotation_evidence VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(s['source_id'],filename+':'+str(ordinal)+':'+str(ai),bid,scope,js(evidence)));report['annotations']+=1;report['mapped_annotations']+=bid is not None
     if bid and scope=='declaration':
      ast=permission(anns,symbols)
      if ast['op']!='unknown':db.execute('INSERT INTO permission_relations(binding_id,source_id,line,annotation,logic,expression_json,raw_annotation) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(bid,s['source_id'],ordinal+1,'external',ast['op'],js(ast),js(anns)))
  if s.get('platform_api_version') is not None and str(s['platform_api_version']) not in exact_index_targets and report['mapped_annotations']<report['annotations']:
   report['status']='partial';issue(s,None,'No imported SDK API index for annotation platform '+str(s['platform_api_version'])+' and unresolved same-snapshot signature targets remain',s['path'],'annotation-platform')
  report['unmatched_annotations']=report['annotations']-report['mapped_annotations']
  report['mapping_status']='complete' if report['unmatched_annotations']==0 else 'partial'
  report['platform_api_version']=s.get('platform_api_version')
 for report in per_source:db.execute('INSERT INTO parse_reports VALUES (?,?)',(report['source_id'],js(report)))
 # One conservative discovery entry; all occurrence documents remain authoritative evidence.
 for (bid,) in db.execute('SELECT binding_id FROM bindings ORDER BY binding_id').fetchall():
  rows=db.execute('SELECT source_id,line,document_json FROM binding_declarations WHERE binding_id=? ORDER BY source_id,line',(bid,)).fetchall()
  def rank(row):
   s=source_by_id[row[0]]
   return (0 if s['kind']=='sdk-signature' else 1 if s['kind']=='source-signature' and s['path'].split('/')[-1]=='current.txt' else 2 if s['kind']=='source-signature' else 3,s['path'])
  rows.sort(key=rank);doc=json.loads(rows[0][2]);doc['provenance']=[p for row in rows for p in json.loads(row[2])['provenance']]
  expressions=[json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute('SELECT expression_json FROM permission_relations WHERE binding_id=?',(bid,))]
  def semantic(a):
   return {k:semantic(v) for k,v in a.items() if not k.startswith('x-')} if isinstance(a,dict) else [semantic(v) for v in a] if isinstance(a,list) else a

def build(inventory,output):
 out=pathlib.Path(output).resolve()
 if out.exists() and list(out.iterdir()):raise ValueError('Output must be empty; preserve immutable earlier publication')
 connections=[]
 try:return _build(inventory,output,connections)
 except Exception as error:
  out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  (out/'validation-failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(published=False,error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)),indent=2))
  raise
 finally:
  for connection in connections:connection.close()

"""Declaration-cache producer contract2. Producers and readers use this helper.
Frozen code is required throughout a run; caches are never relabeled on upgrade.

import pathlib,json,hashlib,sys,importlib.metadata,pyexpat,functools

@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=2)
def current(kind):
 if kind=='java-source':
  names=['java_source.py','parsers.py','foundation_extract.py'];libraries={name:importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ('tree-sitter','tree-sitter-java')}
 elif kind=='sdk-api-index':names=['sdk_api_index.py'];libraries={'expat':pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION}
 else:raise ValueError('No cache producer contract for '+kind)
 names+=['cache_fingerprint.py']
 contract=dict(cache_contract=2,kind=kind,python=list(sys.version_info[:2]),libraries=libraries,code={name:hashlib.sha256((P/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names})

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/contract_reference.py ===
"""Small offline state-machine oracle for API fixtures, NOT an administration service."""
import hashlib,json

class Error(Exception):
    def __init__(self,status):self.status=status

def identity(signature):return hashlib.sha256(signature.encode()).hexdigest()
def digest(document):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(document,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False,ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()

class Catalog:
    def __init__(self):self.entries={};self.registry_generation=1;self.registry_id='fixture-initial';self.overlay_generation=0;self.history={}
    def tag(self,key):
        r=self.entries[key]
        return f'"cat1:{self.registry_generation}:{r["base_hash"] or "local"}:{key}:{r["revision"]}:{r["state"]}"'
    def create(self,signature,document,reason=None):
        key=identity(signature)
        if key in self.entries:raise Error(409)
        self.entries[key]=dict(signature=signature,document=document,state='active',revision=1,base_hash=None,imported=False)
        self.record(key,'create',reason);return key
    def record(self,key,operation,reason=None):
        self.overlay_generation+=1
        self.history.setdefault(key,[]).append(dict(operation=operation,revision=self.entries[key]['revision'],state=self.entries[key]['state']))
        if reason is not None:self.history[key][-1]['reason']=reason
    def precondition(self,key,tag):
        if tag is None:raise Error(428)
        if not isinstance(tag,str) or not tag.startswith('"cat1:') or not tag.endswith('"') or ',' in tag:raise Error(400)
        if key not in self.entries:raise Error(404)
        if tag!=self.tag(key):raise Error(412)
    def put(self,key,tag,document,resolution=None,reason=None):
        self.precondition(key,tag);r=self.entries[key]
        if r['state']=='conflict':
            expected=dict(action='rebase' if r['base_hash'] else 'retain-local',expected_imported_record_sha256=r['base_hash'])
            if resolution!=expected:raise Error(409)
        operation='rebase' if r['state']=='conflict' else 'restore' if r['state'] in ('deleted','suppressed') else 'update'
        r.update(document=document,state='active',revision=r['revision']+1)
        self.record(key,operation,reason);return self.tag(key)
    def delete(self,key,tag,reason=None):
        self.precondition(key,tag);r=self.entries[key]
        if r['state']=='conflict':raise Error(409)
        if r['state'] in ('deleted','suppressed'):return self.tag(key)
        r.update(state='suppressed' if r['imported'] else 'deleted',revision=r['revision']+1)
        self.record(key,'suppress' if r['imported'] else 'delete',reason);return self.tag(key)
    def publish_fixture(self,records):
        """records = complete next selected base. Fixture bypasses staging validation."""
        # Validate all incoming identities/documents before changing selected state.
        for key,(signature,document) in records.items():
            if identity(signature)!=key:raise Error(422)
            digest(document)
        for key,r in list(self.entries.items()):
            if r['imported'] and key not in records:
                if r['revision']==0:
                    del self.entries[key]
                    continue
                r.update(base_hash=None,imported=False,state='conflict',revision=r['revision']+1);self.record(key,'conflict')
        for key,(signature,doc) in records.items():
            if identity(signature)!=key:raise Error(422)
            h=digest(doc)
            if key not in self.entries:self.entries[key]=dict(signature=signature,document=doc,state='active',revision=0,base_hash=h,imported=True)
            else:
                r=self.entries[key]
                if not r['imported'] or (r['base_hash']!=h and r['revision']>0):
                    r.update(state='conflict',revision=r['revision']+1);self.record(key,'conflict')
                elif r['revision']==0:r['document']=doc
                r.update(base_hash=h,imported=True)
        self.registry_generation+=1
        self.registry_id=digest(records)
    def cursor(self):return (self.registry_id,self.registry_generation,self.overlay_generation)
    def continue_page(self,cursor):
        if cursor!=self.cursor():raise Error(410)

"""Offline startup availability/type-graph oracle. No Android, network or probes.
Inputs represent trusted collector evidence fixtures, never remote assertions.
Availability is existence/applicability evidence, never a permission decision.

import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib
import jsonschema
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
STATES=('available','unavailable','unknown')
SCOPE=('profile_id','target_key','android_user_id','backend_instance_id','device_instance_id')
LIMIT=2**53-1
def canonical(value):return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)
def digest(value):return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()
def validate(value,name):
 schema=json.loads((P/'contracts/DeviceResolution.schema.json').read_text());schema['$ref']='#/$defs/'+name;jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(value)
def merge(results,alternative=False):
 if not results:return 'unknown',['APPLICABILITY_MISSING']
 state=('available' if any(s=='available' for s,_ in results) else 'unknown' if any(s=='unknown' for s,_ in results) else 'unavailable') if alternative else ('unavailable' if any(s=='unavailable' for s,_ in results) else 'unknown' if any(s=='unknown' for s,_ in results) else 'available')
 reasons=sorted({r for s,rs in results if s==state for r in rs})
 return state,reasons or ['APPLICABLE_EVIDENCE']
def platform_range(observed,rule):
 lower=tuple(rule['introduced']);upper=tuple(rule['removed']) if rule['removed'] is not None else None
 if upper is not None and upper<=lower:raise ValueError('Invalid platform applicability interval')
 major,minor=observed['major'],observed['minor']
 if major is None:return 'unknown',['PLATFORM_VERSION_UNKNOWN']
 def at_least(bound):
  if major!=bound[0]:return major>bound[0]
  if minor is None:return True if bound[1]==0 else None
  return minor>=bound[1]
 lo=at_least(lower);hi=at_least(upper) if upper is not None else False
 if lo is False or hi is True:return 'unavailable',['PLATFORM_VERSION_EXCLUDED']
 if lo is None or hi is None:return 'unknown',['PLATFORM_MINOR_UNKNOWN']
 return 'available',['PLATFORM_VERSION_MATCH']
def module_range(observed,rule):
 lower=int(rule['introduced']);upper=int(rule['removed']) if rule['removed'] is not None else None
 if lower>2**63-1 or (upper is not None and (upper>2**63-1 or upper<=lower)):raise ValueError('Invalid module version interval')
 if observed is None or observed['state']=='unknown':return 'unknown',['MODULE_VERSION_UNKNOWN']
 if observed['state']=='absent':return ('unavailable',['MODULE_ABSENT']) if observed['authoritative'] else ('unknown',['MODULE_ABSENCE_UNPROVEN'])
 if observed['version'] is None:return 'unknown',['MODULE_VERSION_UNKNOWN']
 version=int(observed['version'])
 if version>2**63-1:raise ValueError('Module version outside int64')
 return ('available',['MODULE_VERSION_MATCH']) if version>=lower and (upper is None or version<upper) else ('unavailable',['MODULE_VERSION_EXCLUDED'])
def clause(rule,facts):
 results=[]
 if 'platform' in rule:results.append(platform_range(facts['platform'],rule['platform']))
 for name,minimum in rule.get('extensions',{}).items():
  observed=facts['extensions'].get(name);results.append(('unknown',['SDK_EXTENSION_UNKNOWN']) if observed is None else ('available',['SDK_EXTENSION_MATCH']) if observed>=minimum else ('unavailable',['SDK_EXTENSION_TOO_OLD']))
 for name,bounds in rule.get('modules',{}).items():results.append(module_range(facts['modules'].get(name),bounds))
 for key,field in (('oem','oem'),('build_fingerprints','build_fingerprint')):
  if key in rule:
   value=facts[field];results.append(('unknown',['BUILD_APPLICABILITY_UNKNOWN']) if value is None else ('available',['BUILD_APPLICABILITY_MATCH']) if value in rule[key] else ('unavailable',['BUILD_APPLICABILITY_EXCLUDED']))
 if 'interface' in rule:
  required=rule['interface'];observed=facts['interfaces'].get(required['descriptor'])
  if observed is None or observed['state']!='reachable':
   results.append(('unavailable',['INTERFACE_AUTHORITATIVELY_ABSENT']) if observed and observed['state']=='absent' and observed['authoritative'] else ('unknown',['INTERFACE_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE']))
  else:
   if required['minimum_version'] is not None:results.append(('unknown',['INTERFACE_VERSION_UNKNOWN']) if observed['version'] is None else ('available',['INTERFACE_VERSION_MATCH']) if observed['version']>=required['minimum_version'] else ('unavailable',['INTERFACE_VERSION_TOO_OLD']))
   if required['accepted_hashes']:results.append(('available',['INTERFACE_HASH_MATCH']) if observed['hash'] in required['accepted_hashes'] else ('unknown',['INTERFACE_HASH_UNRECOGNIZED']))
   if required['minimum_version'] is None and not required['accepted_hashes']:results.append(('unknown',['INTERFACE_CONTRACT_UNPROVEN']))
 return merge(results)
def applicability(rule,facts):
 if 'unknown_reason' in rule:return 'unknown',['APPLICABILITY_UNKNOWN']
 return merge([clause(c,facts) for c in rule['alternatives']],alternative=True)
def variant_key(variant):return variant['schema_hash'],canonical(sorted(variant['dependencies'],key=lambda d:d['entry_id']))
def resolve(inventory,facts,*,registry_id,catalog_generation,overlay_generation,capability_epoch,view_generation):
 validate(facts,'Facts')
 for entity in inventory:validate(entity,'InventoryEntity')
 if len({e['entry_id'] for e in inventory})!=len(inventory):raise ValueError('Duplicate inventory identity')
 for n in (catalog_generation,overlay_generation,capability_epoch,view_generation):
  if not isinstance(n,int) or isinstance(n,bool) or not 0<=n<=LIMIT:raise ValueError('Invalid snapshot counter')
 base={};selected={};output={}
 for entity in inventory:
  key=entity['entry_id'];evaluated=[(v,applicability(v['availability'],facts)) for v in entity['variants']];yes=[v for v,(s,_) in evaluated if s=='available'];maybe=[v for v,(s,_) in evaluated if s=='unknown'];choice=None
  if not facts['identity_verified']:state,reasons='unknown',['DEVICE_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED']
  elif entity['entity_kind']=='other':state,reasons='unknown',['NON_EXECUTABLE_INVENTORY_NODE']
  elif yes:
   signatures={variant_key(v) for v in yes+maybe}
   if len(signatures)!=1:state,reasons='unknown',['VARIANT_AMBIGUOUS']
   else:choice=yes[0];state,reasons='available',['APPLICABLE_EVIDENCE']
  elif maybe:state,reasons='unknown',sorted({r for _,(s,rs) in evaluated if s=='unknown' for r in rs})
  elif evaluated:state,reasons='unavailable',sorted({r for _,(_,rs) in evaluated for r in rs})
  else:state,reasons='unknown',['APPLICABILITY_MISSING']
  base[key]=(state,reasons);selected[key]=choice
  output[key]=dict(entry_id=key,entity_kind=entity['entity_kind'],state=state,reason_codes=reasons,schema_hash=choice['schema_hash'] if choice else None,dependencies=copy.deepcopy(choice['dependencies']) if choice else [])
 # Monotone fixed point propagates missing/excluded schemas through recursive SCCs.
 for _ in range(len(output)+1):
  changed=False
  for key,row in output.items():
   if base[key][0]!='available':continue
   checks=[]
   for required in row['dependencies']:
    dep=output.get(required['entry_id'])
    if dep is None:checks.append(('unknown',['TYPE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING']))
    elif dep['entity_kind']!='type':checks.append(('unknown',['TYPE_DEPENDENCY_NOT_TYPE']))
    elif dep['state']=='unavailable':checks.append(('unavailable',['TYPE_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE']))
    elif dep['state']=='unknown':checks.append(('unknown',['TYPE_DEPENDENCY_UNKNOWN']))
    elif dep['schema_hash']!=required['schema_hash']:checks.append(('unknown',['TYPE_DEPENDENCY_SCHEMA_MISMATCH']))
   state,reasons=merge(checks) if checks else base[key]
   if state!=row['state'] or reasons!=row['reason_codes']:row.update(state=state,reason_codes=reasons);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 else:raise ValueError('Type graph did not converge')
 snapshot=dict(schema_version='1.2.0',registry_id=registry_id,catalog_generation=catalog_generation,overlay_generation=overlay_generation,capability_epoch=capability_epoch,view_generation=view_generation,facts_id=digest(facts),inventory_count=len(inventory),entries=[output[k] for k in sorted(output)],**{k:facts[k] for k in SCOPE})
 snapshot['view_id']=digest(snapshot);validate(snapshot,'Snapshot');return snapshot

class StaleView(Exception):pass
class PreconditionFailed(Exception):
 def __init__(self,status):self.status=status
class ViewStore:
 """Single-thread fixture oracle; a runtime uses an actual DB transaction/lock."""
 def __init__(self,registry_id,catalog_generation,overlay_generation,profile_id,target_key,android_user_id,backend_instance_id,device_instance_id):
  self.catalog=(registry_id,catalog_generation,overlay_generation);self.scope=(profile_id,target_key,android_user_id,backend_instance_id,device_instance_id);self.epoch=0;self.generation=0;self.active=None;self.stale=True
 def invalidate(self,reason):
  if not isinstance(reason,str) or not reason:raise ValueError('Invalidation reason required')
  if self.epoch==LIMIT:raise OverflowError('Capability epoch exhausted')
  self.epoch+=1;self.stale=True
 def change_catalog(self,registry_id,catalog_generation,overlay_generation):
  # Overflow must fail before mutating a catalog pin or the prior active state.
  self.invalidate('catalog-change');self.catalog=(registry_id,catalog_generation,overlay_generation)
 def etag(self):
  return f'"dv1:{digest(list(self.scope))}:{self.generation}:{self.epoch}:{self.catalog[1]}:{self.catalog[2]}"'
 def status(self):
  header={k:copy.deepcopy(v) for k,v in self.active.items() if k!='entries'} if self.active else None
  return dict(header=header,stale=self.stale,capability_epoch=self.epoch,generation=self.generation)
 def request_refresh(self,tag):
  """Fixture for an already authorized scope. No HTTP request or device work."""
  import re
  if tag is None:raise PreconditionFailed(428)
  if not isinstance(tag,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'"dv1:[0-9a-f]{64}:(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*):(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*):(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*):(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)"',tag):raise PreconditionFailed(400)
  if tag!=self.etag():raise PreconditionFailed(412)
  self.invalidate('owner-refresh');return self.status()
 def publish(self,snapshot,*,expected_generation):
  validate(snapshot,'Snapshot');body={k:v for k,v in snapshot.items() if k!='view_id'}
  if snapshot['view_id']!=digest(body):raise ValueError('Snapshot hash mismatch')
  if tuple(snapshot[k] for k in SCOPE)!=self.scope:raise ValueError('Cross-target/profile snapshot')
  if (snapshot['registry_id'],snapshot['catalog_generation'],snapshot['overlay_generation'])!=self.catalog:raise StaleView('Catalog changed')
  if expected_generation!=self.generation or snapshot['view_generation']!=self.generation+1 or snapshot['capability_epoch']!=self.epoch:raise StaleView('Snapshot generation/capability epoch changed')
  entries={e['entry_id']:e for e in snapshot['entries']}
  if len(entries)!=len(snapshot['entries']) or len(entries)!=snapshot['inventory_count']:raise ValueError('Snapshot membership mismatch')
  for row in entries.values():
   if row['state']!='available':continue
   for dep in row['dependencies']:
    target=entries.get(dep['entry_id'])
    if not target or target['entity_kind']!='type' or target['state']!='available' or target['schema_hash']!=dep['schema_hash']:raise ValueError('Incoherent available type dependency')
  # Assignment happens only after every validation; caller inputs are not retained.
  self.active=copy.deepcopy(snapshot);self.generation=snapshot['view_generation'];self.stale=False
 def read(self):return dict(snapshot=copy.deepcopy(self.active),stale=self.stale,capability_epoch=self.epoch,generation=self.generation)

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/dispatch_manifest.py ===
"""Offline generated alias manifest; never executes imported data or enables tools."""
import hashlib,json,sys

def generate(entries):
    seen={}; result=[]
    for entry in sorted(entries,key=lambda e:e['entry_id']):
        canonical=entry['canonical_signature']; bid=hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()
        if bid!=entry['entry_id']: raise ValueError('Canonical identity mismatch')
        if bid in seen: raise ValueError('Duplicate effective entry')
        seen[bid]=True
        document_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entry,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
        contract={key:entry.get(key) for key in ('canonical_signature','kind','arguments','return_type','codec_status')}
        contract['codec_identity']=entry.get('extensions',{}).get('codec_identity')
        digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(contract,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
        permission_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entry.get('permission'),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
        # Names use the full hash, avoiding collision through human-friendly truncation.
        result.append(dict(tool_name='binding_'+bid,policy_tool_id='binding.invoke',binding_id=bid,schema_hash=digest,document_hash=document_hash,permission_hash=permission_hash,
                           generic_binding_id=bid,default_grant='deny',
                           dispatch_state='unavailable',
                           reason='Offline catalog only; runtime authority, target resolver and validated codec required'))
    return dict(format_version='1.0.0',aliases=result)

if __name__=='__main__':
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: entries=[json.loads(x) for x in f if x.strip()]
    with open(sys.argv[2],'x') as f:json.dump(generate(entries),f,indent=2)

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/export_permissions.py ===
"""Read-only permission metadata export to a separate NEW output directory."""
import pathlib,sqlite3,json,hashlib,sys,jsonschema

def run(catalog,output):
 source=pathlib.Path(catalog).resolve();out=pathlib.Path(output).resolve()
 if source==out:raise ValueError('Never write into an immutable release directory')
 if out.exists() and list(out.iterdir()):raise ValueError('Output must be empty')
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 db=sqlite3.connect((source/'catalog.sqlite').as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
 try:
  validator=jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(json.loads((pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'contracts/PermissionSummary.schema.json').read_text()))
  names=[r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT name FROM permission_definitions UNION SELECT value FROM permission_symbols ORDER BY 1')]
  with (out/'permissions.jsonl').open('x') as f:
   for name in names:
    definitions=[dict(source_id=s,protection_level=p,metadata=json.loads(a)) for s,p,a in db.execute('SELECT source_id,protection_level,attributes_json FROM permission_definitions WHERE name=?',(name,))]
    symbols=[dict(symbol=s,source_id=sid,line=n) for s,sid,n in db.execute('SELECT symbol,source_id,line FROM permission_symbols WHERE value=? ORDER BY symbol,source_id,line',(name,))]
    doc=dict(schema_version='1.1.0',permission_id=hashlib.sha256(('permission:'+name).encode()).hexdigest(),name=name,manifest_definitions=definitions,symbols=symbols,metadata_status='manifest-evidence-present' if definitions else 'constant-only; protection-level-and-attributes-unknown',os_authority='unknown',mcp_client_grants='not-inferred')
    validator.validate(doc)
    f.write(json.dumps(doc,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
  samples=[]
  for logic in ('permission','all','any','access','conditional','manual','explicit-none','unknown'):
   for bid,sid,line,expr,raw in db.execute('SELECT binding_id,source_id,line,expression_json,raw_annotation FROM permission_relations WHERE logic=? LIMIT 3',(logic,)):
    samples.append(dict(logic=logic,binding_id=bid,source_id=sid,line=line,expression=json.loads(expr),raw_annotation=json.loads(raw) if raw else None))
  (out/'permission-expression-samples.json').write_text(json.dumps(samples,indent=2))
  summary=dict(permission_names=len(names),manifest_definition_records=db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM permission_definitions').fetchone()[0],source_catalog=str(source),complete=False)
  (out/'permission-coverage.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));return summary
 finally:db.close()

if __name__=='__main__':print(json.dumps(run(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]),indent=2))

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/fetch_snapshot.py ===
"""Materialize exact already-selected snapshot blobs; never changes inventory.
Dry-run by default. --download uses the original Google URL at <=1 request/sec,
honors Retry-After on temporary 429, and stops on every other HTTP error.
"""
import pathlib, json, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error, hashlib, base64, time, email.utils, datetime
inv = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root = inv.parent
sources = json.loads(inv.read_text())['sources']
groups = {}
for s in sources:
    if s['status'] == 'downloaded':
        groups.setdefault(s['git_blob'], s)
pending = [s for s in groups.values() if not (root / s['local_path']).exists()]
print('Missing snapshot blobs:', len(pending), flush=True)
if '--download' not in sys.argv:
    raise SystemExit('Dry run; pass --download for permitted source retrieval')
for i, s in enumerate(pending):
    for retry in range(3):
        try:
            response = urllib.request.urlopen(s['url'] + '?format=TEXT', timeout=45)
            data = base64.b64decode(response.read())
            if not hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == s['sha256']:
                raise ValueError("Validation failed: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == s['sha256']")
            if not hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\x00' + data).hexdigest() == s['git_blob']:
                raise ValueError("Validation failed: hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\\x00' + data).hexdigest() == s['git_blob']")
            p = root / s['local_path']
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_bytes(data)
            break
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code != 429 or retry == 2:
                raise
            header = e.headers.get('Retry-After')
            pause = 60 * (retry + 1)
            if header:
                try:
                    pause = max(pause, float(header))
                except ValueError:
                    pause = max(pause, (email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(header) - datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)).total_seconds())
            while pause > 0:
                step = min(pause, 60)
                time.sleep(step)
                pause -= step
    print(i + 1, '/', len(pending), s['path'], flush=True)
    time.sleep(1)

=== END ARTIFACT ===

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/foundation_extract.py ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Legacy permission-expression helpers only; no importer or executable entry point.

Input: JSON inventory with sources [{path,url,revision,retrieved_at,sha256,
api_level,channel,kind,license}]. Paths relative to the inventory. Kinds:
metalava, manifest, aidl, evidence. Every source must be hash pinned.
Only use a separately verified, exhaustively enumerated stable source inventory.
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, pathlib, re, sqlite3

def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def split_top(text, sep=','):
    result=[]; start=0; stack=[]; quote=None; escape=False
    for i,c in enumerate(text):
        if quote:
            if escape: escape=False
            elif c=='\\': escape=True
            elif c==quote: quote=None
        elif c in '\"\'': quote=c
        elif c in '(<[{': stack.append(c)
        elif c in ')>]}':
            if stack: stack.pop()
        elif c==sep and not stack: result.append(text[start:i].strip());start=i+1
    result.append(text[start:].strip())
    return result

def annotations(text):
    """Balanced annotation scanner, retaining exact expressions and nested annotations."""
    found=[]; clean=[]; pos=0
    while pos<len(text):
        m=re.search(r'@[\w.$]+',text[pos:])
        if not m: clean.append(text[pos:]);break
        a=pos+m.start(); b=pos+m.end();clean.append(text[pos:a]); name=text[a+1:b]
        end=b
        if b<len(text) and text[b]=='(':
            depth=0; quote=None;esc=False
            for end in range(b,len(text)):
                c=text[end]
                if quote:
                    if esc: esc=False
                    elif c=='\\': esc=True
                    elif c==quote: quote=None
                elif c in '\"\'':quote=c
                elif c=='(':depth+=1
                elif c==')':
                    depth-=1
                    if depth==0: end+=1;break
            else: raise ValueError('unclosed annotation')
        found.append((name,text[b+1:end-1] if end>b else '',text[a:end]));pos=end
    return ''.join(clean),found

def permission_ast(name,args):
    short=name.split('.')[-1]
    if short=='RequiresNoPermission':return {'op':'explicit-none'}
    if short=='PermissionManuallyEnforced':return {'op':'manual','reason':'Manual enforcement declared; backend checks unknown'}
    if short in ('Read','Write'):
        _,nested=annotations(args)
        child=permission_ast(nested[0][0],nested[0][1]) if len(nested)==1 else {'op':'unknown','reason':'Unresolved nested annotation','raw':args}
        return {'op':'access','access':short.lower(),'requirement':child}
    pairs={}
    for item in split_top(args):
        if '=' in item:k,v=item.split('=',1);pairs[k.strip()]=v.strip()
        elif item:pairs['value']=item
    def leaf(value):
        if re.fullmatch(r'"[^"\\]+"',value):return {'op':'permission','name':json.loads(value)}
        return {'op':'unknown','reason':'Unresolved symbolic permission expression','raw':value}
    clauses=[]
    for k in ('value','allOf','anyOf'):
        if k not in pairs:continue
        v=pairs[k]
        clauses.append(leaf(v) if k=='value' else {'op':'all' if k=='allOf' else 'any','children':[leaf(x) for x in split_top(v.strip('{}')) if x]})
    ast=clauses[0] if len(clauses)==1 else {'op':'all','children':clauses} if clauses else {'op':'unknown','reason':'Permission expression absent or unsupported','raw':args}
    if pairs.get('conditional')=='true':ast={'op':'conditional','condition':{'op':'unknown','reason':'Annotation marks conditional but does not identify runtime predicate'},'requirement':ast}
    unknown=set(pairs)-{'value','allOf','anyOf','conditional'}
    if unknown:ast={'op':'all','children':[ast,{'op':'unknown','reason':'Unrecognized annotation attributes','raw':args}]}
    return ast

"""Carry per-file Java import context into the runtime source-detail records."""
def attach(sources,reports):
 by_cache={r['cache_path']:r for r in reports}
 for s in sources:

  s['java_file_context']={k:stat.get(k) for k in ('package','imports','wildcard_imports','parser','parse_errors','excluded_implementation_nodes')}

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/java_source.py ===
"""Java source declaration metadata using the pinned Tree-sitter Java grammar.
Method bodies/local/anonymous implementation classes are not API declarations.
All parse errors retain byte/line locators into the immutable complete source.
No imported source is executed, compiled, or loaded as a runtime type.
"""
import re,hashlib,importlib.metadata
from tree_sitter import Language,Parser
import tree_sitter_java
from parsers import annotations,typ,sha
LANGUAGE=Language(tree_sitter_java.language())
TYPE_KINDS={'class_declaration':'class','interface_declaration':'interface','enum_declaration':'enum','annotation_type_declaration':'annotation','record_declaration':'class'}
JAVA_LANG={'String','Object','Class','Throwable','Exception','RuntimeException','Error','Enum','Annotation','Deprecated','Override','SuppressWarnings','SafeVarargs','FunctionalInterface','Boolean','Byte','Character','Short','Integer','Long','Float','Double','Void','Number','CharSequence','StringBuilder','StringBuffer','Iterable','Comparable','Cloneable','AutoCloseable'}
def parse(text,source_path='source.java'):
 data=text.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(text,str) else text;root=Parser(LANGUAGE).parse(data).root_node
 records=[];issues=[];package='';imports={};wildcards=[];excluded={};binary_by_owner={}
 def txt(n):return data[n.start_byte:n.end_byte].decode('utf-8',errors='replace') if n else ''
 for n in root.named_children:
  if n.type=='package_declaration':
   ids=[x for x in n.named_children if x.type in ('identifier','scoped_identifier')];package=txt(ids[-1]) if ids else ''
  elif n.type=='import_declaration':
   value=re.sub(r'^import\s+(?:static\s+)?|;\s*$','',txt(n)).strip()
   if value.endswith('.*'):wildcards.append(value[:-2])
   else:imports[value.split('.')[-1]]=value
 def mask_comments(value):
  return re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'|/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*',lambda m:m.group(0) if m.group(0).startswith(('"',"'")) else ''.join('\n' if c=='\n' else ' ' for c in m.group(0)),value,flags=re.S)
 def qualify_anns(value):
  cleaned=mask_comments(value)
  _,items=annotations(cleaned)
  for a in items:
   raw=a['name'];first,sep,tail=raw.partition('.')
   if first in imports:a['name']=imports[first]+(sep+tail if sep else '');a['name_resolution']='explicit-import'
   elif '.' in raw:a['name_resolution']='qualified-source-spelling'
   elif raw in JAVA_LANG:a['name']='java.lang.'+raw;a['name_resolution']='java-lang'
   elif 'android.annotation' in wildcards and raw in ('RequiresPermission','EnforcePermission','RequiresNoPermission','SystemApi','TestApi','FlaggedApi','Nullable','NonNull'):
    a['name']='android.annotation.'+raw;a['name_resolution']='known-annotation-wildcard'
   else:a['name']=(package+'.' if package else '')+raw;a['name_resolution']='package-candidate; unresolved wildcard imports retained'
   a['source_spelling']=raw
   a['source_raw']=value[a['start']:a['end']]
   args=a['arguments']
   for simple,full in imports.items():args=re.sub(r'(?<![\w.$])'+re.escape(simple)+r'(?=\.)',full,args)
   a['source_arguments']=a['arguments'];a['arguments']=args
  return items
 def modifiers(n):
  m=next((c for c in n.named_children if c.type=='modifiers'),None);value=txt(m);clean,_=annotations(mask_comments(value))
  return re.findall(r'\b(public|protected|private|static|final|abstract|native|synchronized|strictfp|default|transient|volatile|sealed|non-sealed)\b',clean),qualify_anns(value)
 def type_text(n,extra=''):
  raw=txt(n)+extra;clean=typ(raw)
  # Resolve explicit imports without guessing wildcard imports/type variables.
  for simple,full in imports.items():
   if full=='java.lang.'+simple:continue
   clean=re.sub(r'(?<![\w.$])'+re.escape(simple)+r'(?![\w$])',full,clean)
  return clean
 def parameter(n):
  t=n.child_by_field_name('type');name=n.child_by_field_name('name');mod,anns=modifiers(n)
  if n.type=='spread_parameter':
   t=t or next((c for c in n.named_children if c.type not in ('modifiers','variable_declarator','annotation','marker_annotation')),None)
   decl=next((c for c in n.named_children if c.type=='variable_declarator'),None);name=name or (decl.child_by_field_name('name') if decl else None)
  dims=''.join(txt(c) for c in n.named_children if c.type=='dimensions')
  return dict(type=type_text(t,('...' if n.type=='spread_parameter' else '')+dims),name=txt(name) or None,direction=None,annotations=qualify_anns(txt(n)),source_type=txt(t),source_byte_range=[n.start_byte,n.end_byte])
 def row(n,kind,owner,name,return_type=None,parameters=None,canonical=None,anns=None,extra=None,raw=None):
  mods,ma=modifiers(n);parameters=parameters or [];body=n.child_by_field_name('body')
  header=data[n.start_byte:body.start_byte].decode('utf8',errors='replace').strip() if body else txt(n).strip()
  if raw is not None:header=raw
  visibility=next((x for x in mods if x in ('public','protected','private')),None)
  defaults=extra or {}
  if visibility is None:visibility='public' if defaults.get('owner_kind') in ('interface','annotation') and kind in ('method','field','class','interface','enum','annotation') else 'package'
  e=dict(source_path=source_path,source_byte_range=[n.start_byte,n.end_byte],modifiers=mods,effective_visibility=visibility,owner_binary_name=binary_by_owner.get(owner),public_sdk_membership='unknown until checked against published SDK metadata');e.update(defaults)
  return dict(kind=kind,canonical=canonical or owner+'#'+name,owner=owner,package=package,name=name,return_type=return_type,parameters=parameters,annotations=ma if anns is None else anns,all_annotations=qualify_anns(header),raw=header,line=n.start_point[0]+1,extras=e)
 def excluded_node(kind):excluded[kind]=excluded.get(kind,0)+1
 def type_decl(n,outer=None,depth=0,owner_kind=None):
  if depth>128:issues.append(dict(reason='Nested type depth exceeds128',line=n.start_point[0]+1,byte_range=[n.start_byte,n.end_byte]));return
  name=txt(n.child_by_field_name('name'));owner=outer+'.'+name if outer else (package+'.' if package else '')+name;kind=TYPE_KINDS[n.type]
  binary_by_owner[owner]=binary_by_owner[outer]+'$'+name if outer else (package.replace('.','/')+'/' if package else '')+name
  r=row(n,kind,owner,name,canonical=owner,extra=dict(owner_kind=owner_kind,declaration_kind=n.type,type_parameters=txt(n.child_by_field_name('type_parameters')),superclass=txt(n.child_by_field_name('superclass')),interfaces=txt(n.child_by_field_name('interfaces'))));records.append(r)
  record_parameters=n.child_by_field_name('parameters') if n.type=='record_declaration' else None
  if record_parameters:
   for component in record_parameters.named_children:
    if component.type not in ('formal_parameter','spread_parameter'):continue
    value=parameter(component)
    records.append(row(component,'field',owner,value['name'],value['type'],anns=[],extra=dict(owner_kind=kind,record_component=True,record_component_annotations=value['annotations'],annotation_scope='component; target propagation unresolved',effective_visibility='unknown; source record component metadata')))
  body=n.child_by_field_name('body')
  if body is None:return
  def child(c):
   if c.type in TYPE_KINDS:type_decl(c,owner,depth+1,kind)
   elif c.type=='enum_body_declarations':
    for x in c.named_children:child(x)
   elif c.type in ('method_declaration','constructor_declaration','compact_constructor_declaration','annotation_type_element_declaration'):
    ctor=c.type in ('constructor_declaration','compact_constructor_declaration');name=txt(c.child_by_field_name('name'));ps=record_parameters if c.type=='compact_constructor_declaration' else c.child_by_field_name('parameters');params=[];receivers=[]
    if ps:
     for p in ps.named_children:
      if p.type in ('formal_parameter','spread_parameter'):params.append(parameter(p))
      elif p.type=='receiver_parameter':receivers.append(txt(p))
    canonical=owner+'#'+('<init>' if ctor else name)+'('+','.join(p['type'] for p in params)+')'
    mods,anns=modifiers(c);r=row(c,'constructor' if ctor else 'method',owner,name,None if ctor else type_text(c.child_by_field_name('type')),params,canonical,anns,dict(owner_kind=kind,type_parameters=txt(c.child_by_field_name('type_parameters')),receiver_parameters=receivers,default_value_raw=txt(c.child_by_field_name('value')),source_declared_constructor=ctor))
    records.append(r)
   elif c.type in ('field_declaration','constant_declaration'):
    t=c.child_by_field_name('type');mods,anns=modifiers(c)
    for v in c.named_children:
     if v.type!='variable_declarator':continue
     name=txt(v.child_by_field_name('name'));value=v.child_by_field_name('value');dims=''.join(txt(x) for x in v.named_children if x.type=='dimensions');value_raw=txt(value)
     raw=txt(c);extra=dict(owner_kind=kind,constant_raw=value_raw if len(value_raw)<=4096 else None,initializer_source_range=[value.start_byte,value.end_byte] if value else None,enum_constant=False)
     if len(raw)>16384:raw=type_text(t)+' '+name+' [initializer retained at source byte range]';extra['raw_signature_is_excerpt']=True
     records.append(row(c,'field',owner,name,type_text(t,dims),anns=anns,extra=extra,raw=raw))
   elif c.type=='enum_constant':
    name=txt(c.child_by_field_name('name'));records.append(row(c,'field',owner,name,owner,extra=dict(owner_kind='enum',enum_constant=True,effective_visibility='public')))
   elif c.type not in ('line_comment','block_comment'):excluded_node(c.type)
  for c in body.named_children:child(c)
 if package:
  n=next(n for n in root.named_children if n.type=='package_declaration');records.append(row(n,'package',None,package,canonical=package,extra=dict(declaration_kind='package')))
 for n in root.named_children:
  if n.type in TYPE_KINDS:type_decl(n)
  elif n.type not in ('package_declaration','import_declaration','line_comment','block_comment'):excluded_node(n.type)
 def errors(n):
  if n.type=='ERROR' or n.is_missing:
   issues.append(dict(reason='Java AST '+('missing token' if n.is_missing else 'ERROR'),line=n.start_point[0]+1,byte_range=[n.start_byte,n.end_byte],raw_excerpt=txt(n)[:4096],source_bytes_retained=True))
  elif n.has_error:
   for c in n.children:errors(c)
 errors(root)
 for issue in issues:
  locator=str(issue['byte_range']);raw=issue.get('raw_excerpt','')
  records.append(dict(kind='unsupported',canonical='unparsed-java:'+source_path+':'+locator+':'+sha(raw),owner=None,package=package,name='unparsed',return_type=None,parameters=[],annotations=[],all_annotations=[],raw=raw,line=issue['line'],extras=dict(parse_error=issue['reason'],source_byte_range=issue['byte_range'])))
 return dict(records=records,issues=issues,parse_errors=len(issues),package=package,imports=imports,wildcard_imports=wildcards,excluded_implementation_nodes=excluded,parser='tree-sitter-java'+importlib.metadata.version('tree-sitter-java')+' / tree-sitter'+importlib.metadata.version('tree-sitter'))

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/jvm_source_link.py ===
"""Exact link only when a source type has a proven current SDK JVM spelling.
No wildcard-import guesses or type-variable bound erasure are performed.
Generics' outer types may be erased only when that outer type is known.
"""
PRIMITIVES={'byte':'B','char':'C','double':'D','float':'F','int':'I','long':'J','short':'S','boolean':'Z','void':'V'}
def encode(value,owner,owners):
 if not value:return None
 value=value.replace('...','[]').strip();dims=0
 while value.endswith('[]'):dims+=1;value=value[:-2].strip()
 if value in PRIMITIVES:
  if value=='void' and dims:return None
  return '['*dims+PRIMITIVES[value]
 # Strip balanced parameterized arguments, retaining the outer known type.
 depth=0;outer=[]
 for c in value:
  if c=='<':depth+=1
  elif c=='>':
   depth-=1
   if depth<0:return None
  elif depth==0:outer.append(c)
 if depth:return None
 value=''.join(outer).strip()
 candidate=owners.get(value)
 # Same-package/nested candidates are not assumed in the presence of unresolved
 # imports/type-variable shadowing; only explicitly qualified names link here.
 return '['*dims+'L'+candidate+';' if candidate else None
def key(r,owners):
 owner=r['extras'].get('owner_binary_name')
 if not owner or owners.get(r['owner'])!=owner:return None
 if r['kind'] in ('class','interface','enum','annotation'):return owner
 # The lifecycle index lacks a field descriptor/type. A same-name field is
 # retained as source evidence but cannot prove a typed JVM identity.
 if r['kind']=='field':return None
 if r['kind'] not in ('method','constructor'):return None
 args=[encode(p['type'],r['owner'],owners) for p in r['parameters']]
 ret='V' if r['kind']=='constructor' else encode(r.get('return_type'),r['owner'],owners)
 if ret is None or any(a is None or a=='V' for a in args):return None
 return owner+'#'+('<init>' if r['kind']=='constructor' else r['name'])+'('+''.join(args)+')'+ret

=== END ARTIFACT ===

=== UNTRUSTED ARTIFACT catalog/tooling/migrate_v3.py ===
"""Checked offline COPY migration. Never modifies original release or active files."""
import pathlib,sqlite3,json,os,sys
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def migrate(source,destination):
    source=pathlib.Path(source).resolve();target=pathlib.Path(destination).resolve()
    staging=target.with_suffix(target.suffix+'.staging')
    if target.exists() or staging.exists():raise ValueError('Destination must be new')
    old=sqlite3.connect(source.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True);old.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    if old.execute('PRAGMA user_version').fetchone()[0]!=2:raise ValueError('Only storage user_version=2 can migrate to v3')
    if old.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]!='ok' or old.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall():raise ValueError('Source integrity/FK failure')
    new=sqlite3.connect(staging);new.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON')
    try:
        for p in sorted((P/'migrations').glob('*.sql')):new.executescript(p.read_text())
        # SQLite optimizer statistics are internal and are regenerated, not imported.
        tables=[r[0] for r in old.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")]
        new.execute('PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=ON');new.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
        registry_states={};active_rows=[];overlay_rows=[]
        for table in tables:
            if table=='catalog_view':continue
            if table=='active_registry':
                active_rows=[dict(row) for row in old.execute('SELECT * FROM active_registry')]
                continue
            if table=='overlays':
                overlay_rows=[dict(row) for row in old.execute('SELECT * FROM overlays')]
                continue
            if table=='effective_entries':
                active=old.execute('SELECT registry_id FROM active_registry WHERE singleton=1').fetchone()
                if not active and old.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM effective_entries').fetchone()[0]:raise ValueError('No active registry for legacy effective entries')
                for row in old.execute('SELECT entry_id,document_json,record_sha256 FROM effective_entries'):
                    new.execute('INSERT INTO registry_entries VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(active[0],row[0],row[1],row[2]))
                if new.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM registry_entries').fetchone()[0]!=old.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM effective_entries').fetchone()[0]:raise ValueError('Entry count mismatch')
                continue
            for row in old.execute('SELECT * FROM "'+table+'"'):
                r=dict(row)
                if table in ('registries','import_jobs') and 'status' in r:r['state']=r.pop('status')
                if table=='registries':registry_states[r['registry_id']]=r['state'];r['state']='staged'
                if table=='permission_relations':r['logic']=json.loads(r['expression_json'])['op']
                if table=='catalog_meta' and r['key']=='schema_version':r['value']='1.2.0'
                if table=='effective_entries':r['etag']='"cat1:1:'+r['record_sha256']+':'+r['entry_id']+':0:active"'
                destination_table='legacy_import_jobs' if table=='import_jobs' else table
                cols=','.join('"'+k+'"' for k in r)
                new.execute('INSERT INTO "'+destination_table+'"('+cols+') VALUES('+','.join('?' for _ in r)+')',list(r.values()))
            actual=new.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM "'+('legacy_import_jobs' if table=='import_jobs' else table)+'"').fetchone()[0]
            expected=old.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM "'+table+'"').fetchone()[0]
            if actual!=expected:raise ValueError('Count mismatch '+table)
        # Load only into private staged registries. Seal every original terminal
        # state after complete membership copy; restore retired before published.
        for key,state in sorted(registry_states.items(),key=lambda item:item[1]=='published'):
            path={'staged':[],'rejected':['rejected'],'validated':['validated'],'published':['validated','published'],'retired':['validated','published','retired']}[state]
            for next_state in path:new.execute('UPDATE registries SET state=? WHERE registry_id=?',(next_state,key))
        for row in active_rows:
            new.execute('INSERT INTO active_registry(singleton,registry_id) VALUES(?,?)',(row['singleton'],row['registry_id']))
        if new.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM active_registry').fetchone()[0]!=len(active_rows):raise ValueError('Active pointer count mismatch')
        # Admit copied overlays only against the restored active base. Both local
        # collision and imported-base guards run; invalid historical bases reject.
        for row in overlay_rows:
            cols=','.join('"'+k+'"' for k in row)
            new.execute('INSERT INTO overlays('+cols+') VALUES('+','.join('?' for _ in row)+')',list(row.values()))
        if new.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM overlays').fetchone()[0]!=len(overlay_rows):raise ValueError('Overlay count mismatch')
        new.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_meta VALUES('rebuilt_with_corrected_extractor','false')")
        new.execute('UPDATE catalog_view SET registry_generation=(SELECT registry_version FROM registries WHERE registry_id=(SELECT registry_id FROM active_registry WHERE singleton=1)) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_registry)')
        if new.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]!='ok' or new.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall():raise ValueError('Migrated integrity/FK failure')
        new.commit();new.close();old.close();os.rename(staging,target)
    except Exception:
        new.rollback();new.close();old.close()
        # Preserve failed staging bytes for diagnosis; never present as published output.
        raise

if __name__=='__main__':migrate(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2])
